title: The Pea Shoots in the Clay Pot
youtube_title: The Pea Shoots in the Clay Pot | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Waiting kindly is a way of taking care.
summary: At a cottage windowsill of jars, trays, and drying wool, Idris wants to check on a pea shoots under a paper hood before it is ready. With the ferryman nearby, Idris leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
